Employee.title: Employee
Employee.description: A natural person employed by the organisation. Carries the identity, payroll, and wage-tax attributes the payroll/wage-tax compliance checks read (BSN, tax table colour, ID-document retention, 30%-ruling, A1 posting, minimum-wage basis).

bsn.description: Burgerservicenummer (NL tax identification). Presence drives the anoniementarief check (nl-anoniementarief).

endDate.description: Employment end date, or null while active.

grossMonthlySalary.description: Gross monthly salary in the pay currency.

taxTableColor.description: Loonheffing tax table colour (wit = current employment, groen = pensions/benefits). Drives the combined loonheffing/volksverzekeringen levy (nl-loonheffingen-volksverzekeringen).

identityDocumentVerified.description: Whether a valid identity document was verified and copied into the loonadministratie (nl-id-bewaarplicht-5jaar).

identityDocumentRetainedUntil.description: Date until which the ID-document copy is retained — at least 5 years after the year employment ends (nl-id-bewaarplicht-5jaar).

loonheffingenVerklaringOnFile.description: Whether the employee's loonheffingenverklaring (wage-tax statement) is on file.

elstamRetrieved.description: DE: whether the ELStAM electronic wage-tax features were retrieved (de-elstam-abruf).

steuerklasse.description: DE: Lohnsteuer tax class (Steuerklasse I-VI) applied from ELStAM (de-elstam-abruf).

w4OnFile.description: US: whether a Form W-4 is on file for the employee (us-w4-on-file).

i9VerifiedWithinThreeDays.description: US: whether work eligibility was verified on Form I-9 within 3 business days of start (us-i9-verification).

newHireReportedDate.description: US: date the new hire was reported to the state Directory of New Hires (us-new-hire-reporting).

a1CertificateNumber.description: EU: A1 posted-worker certificate number, when the employee is posted (eu-a1-posted-worker).

a1ValidUntil.description: EU: A1 certificate expiry — max 24 months after posting start (eu-a1-posted-worker).

postedWorker.description: EU: whether the employee is posted to another member state remaining home-insured (eu-a1-posted-worker).

thirtyPercentRulingGranted.description: NL: whether a 30%-beschikking has been granted (nl-30-percent-regeling / nl-30-regeling-aftoppingsgrens).

thirtyPercentRulingRate.description: NL: applied 30%-ruling percentage; must not exceed 30 for 2025-2026 (nl-30-percent-regeling).

thirtyPercentCappedAtWntNorm.description: NL: whether the 30%-ruling tax-free base is capped at the WNT-norm (nl-30-regeling-aftoppingsgrens).

EmploymentContract.title: Employment Contract
EmploymentContract.description: An employment agreement between the organisation and an employee. Carries the contract attributes the payroll checks read (permanent/temporary type that drives the Awf low/high premium, contracted hours, CAO, minimum-wage hourly basis).

employeeId.description: Reference to the Employee this contract belongs to.

type.description: Contract type. 'permanent' (written, indefinite) takes the Awf low tariff; flexible/temporary take the high tariff (nl-awf-laag-hoog-tarief).

writtenContract.description: Whether the contract is in writing — a precondition for the Awf low tariff (nl-awf-laag-hoog-tarief).

endDate.description: Contract end date, or null for indefinite.

hoursPerWeek.description: Contracted hours per week. Used with the statutory hourly minimum to derive period minimums (nl-minimumuurloon-wet).

hourlyWage.description: Gross hourly wage. Must meet the statutory minimum hourly wage (nl-minimumloon-2026 / nl-minimumuurloon-wet / de-mindestlohn-2026 / fr-smic-2026 / us-flsa-minimum-wage).

cao.description: Applicable collective labour agreement (CAO / convention collective), when any.

awfTariff.description: Applied Awf (unemployment fund) tariff — low for permanent written contracts, high otherwise (nl-awf-laag-hoog-tarief).

workingTimeDocumented.description: DE: whether daily working time is recorded within 7 days and retained ≥2 years for §17 MiLoG sectors/Minijobs (de-mindestlohn-arbeitszeit-doku).

overtimeMultiplier.description: US: overtime pay multiplier for hours over 40/week for non-exempt employees — must be ≥1.5 (us-flsa-overtime).

ftePartOfYearMinijob.description: DE: whether the contract is a Minijob within the geringfügige Beschäftigung threshold using flat-rate contributions (de-minijob-pauschale).

dpaeFiledBeforeStart.description: FR: whether the Déclaration Préalable À l'Embauche (DPAE) was filed in the 8 days before the hire (fr-dpae).

Payslip.title: Payslip
Payslip.description: A per-employee, per-period wage statement (loonstrook / Lohnabrechnung / bulletin de paie / pay stub). Carries the gross-to-net composition the payroll-withholding, social-security, and statutory-content checks read.

period.description: Wage period in YYYY-MM (or YYYY-Pnn for four-weekly).

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country whose payroll rules govern this payslip (NL/DE/FR/US).

grossPay.description: Gross wage for the period (BR for loonstrook content).

hoursWorked.description: Hours worked in the period; with grossPay yields the effective hourly rate for minimum-wage checks.

loonheffing.description: NL: combined loonheffing (loonbelasting + premie volksverzekeringen) withheld (nl-loonheffingen-inhouding / nl-loonheffingen-volksverzekeringen).

volksverzekeringen.description: NL: premie volksverzekeringen portion within the loonheffing (nl-loonheffingen-volksverzekeringen).

werknemersverzekeringen.description: NL: employer-borne premies werknemersverzekeringen (WW/WIA/ZW) over the wage (nl-werknemersverzekeringen-werkgever).

zvw.description: NL: Zvw contribution (werkgeversheffing or withheld bijdrage) for the period (nl-zvw-werkgeversheffing / nl-zvw-inhouding).

zvwMode.description: NL: whether the Zvw is the employer levy (6,10%) or the withheld lower rate (4,85%) (nl-zvw-werkgeversheffing / nl-zvw-inhouding).

zvwRate.description: NL: applied Zvw rate percentage (6.10 for werkgeversheffing, 4.85 for inhouding).

anoniementariefApplied.description: NL: whether the 52% anoniementarief was applied because identity/BSN data is missing (nl-anoniementarief).

appliedTaxRate.description: NL: effective loonheffing rate percentage applied; 52 when the anoniementarief is in force (nl-anoniementarief).

nettoPay.description: Net wage paid to the employee.

vakantiegeldReserved.description: Vakantiebijslag reserved this period — at least 8% of gross (nl-vakantiebijslag-8procent).

vakantiegeldRate.description: Applied vakantiebijslag rate percentage — at least 8 (nl-vakantiebijslag-8procent).

wkrUsed.description: NL: designated WKR allowances charged this period against the vrije ruimte (nl-wkr-vrije-ruimte).

wkrVrijeRuimteRemaining.description: NL: remaining WKR vrije ruimte after this payslip — must not go negative without eindheffing (nl-wkr-vrije-ruimte).

wkrEindheffingRate.description: NL: 80% eindheffing rate applied to WKR excess (nl-wkr-eindheffing-80).

wkrExcess.description: NL: WKR allowances exceeding the vrije ruimte that attract the 80% eindheffing (nl-wkr-eindheffing-80).

pensionContribution.description: Employee pension contribution withheld for the period.

statementProvided.description: Whether a written/electronic payslip was provided to the employee.

showsGrossWage.description: NL/FR: whether the payslip states the gross wage (nl-loonstrook-inhoud / fr-bulletin-de-paie-mentions).

showsDeductionBasis.description: NL: whether the payslip states the amount and basis of each deduction (nl-loonstrook-inhoud).

showsMinimumWage.description: NL: whether the payslip states the applicable statutory minimum wage (nl-loonstrook-inhoud).

showsEmployerEmployeeIds.description: NL: whether the payslip states employer and employee identification (nl-loonstrook-inhoud).

lohnsteuer.description: DE: Lohnsteuer withheld for the period (de-lohnsteuer-einbehalt).

solidaritaetszuschlag.description: DE: Solidaritätszuschlag of 5,5% of the Lohnsteuer above the Freigrenze (de-solidaritaetszuschlag).

solzApplicable.description: DE: whether the Soli applies (employee above the Freigrenze) (de-solidaritaetszuschlag).

kirchensteuer.description: DE: Kirchensteuer (8%/9% of Lohnsteuer) where the employee is a church member (de-kirchensteuer).

kirchensteuerRate.description: DE: applied Kirchensteuer rate percentage (8 or 9) (de-kirchensteuer).

churchMember.description: DE: whether the employee is a member of a tax-collecting religious community (de-kirchensteuer).

kvBaseRate.description: DE: general health-insurance base rate — 14,6% for 2026 (de-kv-beitragssatz-2026).

svContributionBase.description: DE: social-security contribution base used for RV/AV (capped at the BBG) (de-bbg-rv-av-2026).

kvPvContributionBase.description: DE: KV/PV contribution base (capped at the KV/PV BBG) (de-bbg-kv-pv-2026).

ficaSsWageBaseApplied.description: US: Social Security taxable wage capped at the annual wage base (us-social-security-wage-base-2026).

additionalMedicareApplied.description: US: whether the additional 0,9% Medicare tax applies (wages over $200k YTD) (us-additional-medicare-tax).

federalIncomeTaxWithheld.description: US: federal income tax withheld using Form W-4 / Pub. 15-T (us-federal-income-tax-withholding).

netImposable.description: FR: net imposable shown on the bulletin de paie (fr-bulletin-de-paie-mentions).

netAPayer.description: FR: net à payer shown on the bulletin de paie (fr-bulletin-de-paie-mentions).

montantNetSocial.description: FR: montant net social — standardised reference amount on the bulletin (fr-montant-net-social).

cotisations.description: FR: total URSSAF social cotisations on the gross assiette (fr-urssaf-cotisations).

prelevementSource.description: FR: prélèvement à la source income tax withheld (fr-prelevement-a-la-source).

pasRate.description: FR: PAS rate transmitted by the administration via DSN (fr-prelevement-a-la-source).

reductionGeneraleApplied.description: FR: whether the réduction générale (ex-Fillon) is applied on remuneration below 1,6 SMIC (fr-reduction-generale).

conventionCollective.description: FR: applicable convention collective shown on the bulletin (fr-bulletin-de-paie-mentions).

retainedUntil.description: Date until which the payslip duplicate is retained — 5 years FR (fr-bulletin-conservation) / 4-year IRC + 3-year FLSA US.

PayrollRun.title: Payroll Run
PayrollRun.description: A per-period payroll batch that aggregates the payslips of one administration. Carries the period totals the payroll-to-GL reconciliation and liability-clearing controls read.

administrationId.description: The administration/employer this run belongs to. No Administration schema is modeled in hrmq — plain string, not a $ref relation (ADR-062 rule 7: only fields whose target exists in this register set get $ref).

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country governing this run.

totalGross.description: Total gross wages for the period.

totalLoonheffing.description: Total loonheffing / wage tax withheld for the period.

totalEmployerCharges.description: Total employer social charges for the period.

totalWithholdings.description: Total employee withholdings (tax + social) for the period.

totalNet.description: Total net pay for the period.

glLiabilityPosted.description: Amount posted to payroll liability accounts in the GL — must reconcile to gross+employer charges−net (xc-payroll-gl-reconciliation).

glExpensePosted.description: Amount posted to payroll expense accounts in the GL — must reconcile to gross+employer charges (xc-payroll-gl-reconciliation).

withholdingsClearedToZero.description: Whether each tax/social withholding liability was cleared to zero when remitted (xc-withholding-liability-clearing).

withholdingLiabilityBalance.description: Residual withholding-liability balance after remittance — zero when cleared (xc-withholding-liability-clearing).

LoonaangifteFiling.title: Wage Tax Filing
LoonaangifteFiling.description: A wage-tax / social-security filing for one wage period (NL loonaangifte / DE Lohnsteuer-Anmeldung & Beitragsnachweis / FR DSN / US Form 941 & deposits). Carries the period, deadline, submission, and tijdvak attributes the filing-window checks read.

period.description: Wage period the filing covers, in YYYY-MM.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country governing this filing (NL/DE/FR/US).

filingType.description: Filing kind: loonaangifte / lohnsteuer-anmeldung / beitragsnachweis / deuv-meldung / lohnsteuerbescheinigung / dsn / form-941 / form-940 / deposit / form-w2.

tijdvak.description: Filing period type (tijdvak / Anmeldungszeitraum / deposit schedule) (nl-loonaangifte-tijdvak / de-lohnsteuer-anmeldungszeitraum / us-deposit-schedule-lookback).

deadline.description: Statutory filing/payment deadline (ISO 8601). NL: last working day of the month after the period (nl-loonaangifte-termijn). DE: 10th of the following month (de-lohnsteuer-anmeldung). FR: 5th/15th (fr-dsn-echeance). US: last day of month after quarter (us-form-941-quarterly).

submittedDate.description: Date the filing was submitted electronically — must be on or before the deadline.

paidDate.description: Date the related contributions/taxes were paid.

electronicallyFiled.description: Whether the filing was submitted electronically (nl-loonaangifte-tijdvak / de-lohnsteuer-anmeldung / fr-dsn-mensuelle / us-eftps-deposit).

priorYearLiability.description: DE: prior-year Lohnsteuer that determines the Anmeldungszeitraum thresholds (de-lohnsteuer-anmeldungszeitraum).

lookbackLiability.description: US: employment-tax liability in the lookback period that sets the deposit schedule (us-deposit-schedule-lookback).

depositSchedule.description: US: federal deposit schedule derived from the lookback liability (us-deposit-monthly / us-deposit-semiweekly).

accumulatedLiability.description: US: accumulated employment-tax liability driving the $100k next-day and $500 FUTA deposit rules (us-deposit-100k-next-day / us-futa-deposit-500).

nextDayDepositMade.description: US: whether a next-business-day deposit was made when liability reached $100k (us-deposit-100k-next-day).

eventSignalDays.description: FR: working days taken to transmit an event signalement — must be ≤5 (fr-dsn-evenementielle).

furnishedToRecipientDate.description: US/DE: date the year-end statement (W-2 to employee, Lohnsteuerbescheinigung) was furnished (us-form-w2-to-employee / de-lohnsteuerbescheinigung).

filedWithAuthorityDate.description: US: date Copy A / W-3 transmittal was filed with the SSA (us-form-w2-w3-to-ssa).

returnCountInYear.description: US: aggregate information returns filed in the year, driving the 10-return e-file rule (us-w2-efile-threshold).

retainedUntil.description: Date until which the filing records are retained (NL 7yr / DE 6yr / US 4yr).
